Followed the individuals and arrived shortly after at Cotton On; standing by in case any further theft is committed. Cotton On staff notified to be aware.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Welfare checks at McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store Queen Street and Bar 101 completed; all clear, no issues to report. Remaining on standby at Bar 101.
A large pub-crawl group entered Bar 101; remaining on standby to assist the on-site security guards if required.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed; all clear, no issues to report. Remaining available for calls.
Wellesley Street checked; all clear, no issues to report.

Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street completed; SkyCity and surrounding areas also checked, no incidents reported. Several individuals observed around the convenience store; remaining available for calls.
Federal Street and St Patrick's Cathedral checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke completed; the bar was closed and no issues were reported.
Albert Street Mart Convenience Store checked; all clear, no issues to report.

Fort Lane checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Jo & Joes completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Chancery Square checked; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Radisson RED Hotel completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Lorne Street checked; welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street also completed. All clear, no issues to report.
Returned to Headquarters for the break and to charge the Ops Phone, as the battery had dropped to 10%.
Call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding an intoxicated male inside the restaurant; responding to the call.

Attended McDonald's Queen Street and approached a heavily intoxicated male who had been sleeping inside the restaurant. When asked to wake up and leave, the individual became aggressive, directed racist remarks at the team, and issued verbal threats towards the HOTC Safety Team, including threats of physical violence, stating "I will smack your face and will remember you." He also recorded videos and took photographs of officers while repeatedly challenging them to fight. The confrontation continued inside the restaurant for approximately 13 minutes. The individual eventually exited the premises but continued making threats towards officers outside; after approximately 15 minutes he departed towards Aotea Square before returning and again verbally threatening the Safety Team.

Instructed the individual to leave the area and proceeded towards Headquarters; no further incidents reported apart from the confrontation at McDonald's Queen Street. Shift handover to the morning team completed.
